adjudication_records.issue_text: model/infinispan/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/cache/infinispan/idp/InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:414 — Duplicated all-login-cache invalidation loop can drift between create/remove and update paths.

adjudication.rationale: The finding claims there's a 'duplicated all-login-cache invalidation loop' that 'can drift between create/remove and update paths'. Looking at the diff, there are two methods: registerIDPLoginInvalidation() (lines 381-387) used for create/remove, and registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate() (lines 397-419) used for update. Both contain the same loop 'for (FetchMode mode : FetchMode.values())' to invalidate caches. This is intentional design - the update method has additional logic to check if invalidation is needed, while create/remove always invalidate. The loops are identical and there's no 'drift' issue - they both iterate over FetchMode.values() and call the same invalidation method. This is not a bug but rather appropriate code organization.

adjudication_records.issue_text: testsuite/integration-arquillian/tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/testsuite/organization/cache/OrganizationCacheTest.java:417 — The cache test never verifies invalidation or refreshed results after creating or removing a login-eligible provider.

adjudication.rationale: The finding claims the test never verifies invalidation after creating/removing a login-eligible provider, but this is false. Looking at the test code around lines 417-536, the test explicitly: (1) creates IDPs and verifies caches are populated, (2) adds/removes IDPs not available for login and verifies caches remain, (3) updates an IDP to change login availability and verifies caches are cleared (assertNull checks), (4) links an IDP to an org and verifies caches are cleared. The test thoroughly covers invalidation scenarios for login-eligible providers.

adjudication_records.issue_text: testsuite/integration-arquillian/tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/testsuite/organization/cache/OrganizationCacheTest.java:400 — The test inspects cache internals but never consumes a cache-hit getForLogin stream to verify the returned providers match the delegate behavior.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that the test `testCacheIDPForLogin` verifies cache internals (checking that IdentityProviderListQuery objects exist and have correct sizes) but doesn't verify that consuming the cached results via `getForLogin()` returns the correct IdentityProviderModel objects. The test calls `session.identityProviders().getForLogin()` but doesn't consume/verify the returned stream contents - it only checks the cache query metadata. This is a valid test coverage concern for the new caching functionality added in this diff, though the test does verify cache invalidation behavior and cache entry sizes.
